_what: THE AMR TEST'S OWN CANDIDATES, with their real field values (req-P1-THE-EVALUATOR-six-checks-in-code). These are DECLARATIONS AND RECORDED READINGS, not a live probe: the evaluator does not fetch (out of scope).
_provenance: The field values are the ones the AMR discovery test read on 2026-11-11 (DISCOVERY TEST — antimicrobial resistance in East Africa, section 3, 'WHAT THE DATA SURFACES FOUND — and the six-point verdict').

TWO licence readings were re-read by the farm itself on 2026-11-20 and are quoted from the pages as fetched that day, with the sha256 of the fetched bytes: WHO's CC BY 4.0 terms (page) and Africa CDC's MAAP download page ('(c) All rights reserved Africa CDC', page).

The HF reading stays on the 2026-11-11 record: the same API answered HTTP 401 on 2026-11-20 (a token is required now), so the tag 'cc-by-4.0' is quoted from the reading that WAS made, and the 401 is written in the candidate's note rather than papered over.
Nothing here is fabricated: a field with no reading is marked with its kind ('stated', 'none') and the evaluator refuses it by name.
